items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: Yeah, I was right there in the band. See, we had a little thing they called them the Cab Jivers... Diz and Jonah and all them sitting back there in that bandstand

ctx.x: Well he would help, I've seen him help a lot of tenor players. I've seen him help musicians. On a lot of things, talk, recommend them on jobs and help 'em. I've seen him sit down and help them with their music. They would come up and ask him different questions from being out on the road, you know, not only tenor players, trumpet players and trombone players sit down because Chu was very popular. They'd come up and start talking to Chu and he would take his own time to sit down and talk to them and I think that…
I read somewhere that he was not too fond of Dizzy's playing.

Well not too many people were then, you know, because I know Cab used to say, now the trumpet players in the band idolized Dizzy for what he was doing, but Cab there when Diz was with Cab you know, he'd get up there and Cab couldn't dig him too well, you know, he's up there playing. And then a lot of times maybe another trumpet player, Shad Collins or Jonah would come up and play a solo
